memory_candidates.content: When a shell script sources ${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/common.sh, it cannot run from a source-store checkout at all (lib/ only exists in the post-deploy flattened .claude/scripts/ tree). Its test suite needs a deployed-layout scratch fixture: copy the script plus deploy-root-guard.sh and lib/common.sh into <scratch>/.claude/scripts/ (and lib/), git init the scratch dir with a seed commit, and let common_repo_root resolve PROJECT_ROOT to the scratch root. When a sibling script in the same suite already has this exact fixture (e.g. a read-side script's build_scratch helper), clone its shape verbatim for a new write-side script's fixture rather than inventing a different one -- the two fixtures should differ only in which extra files they copy.

When a Batch Gate Deferral directive permits discharging a plan phase's full-tier verification against a scoped --only-gate N[,...] invocation, map the phase's own declared criteria to the actual gate numbering deploy-headless.sh/verify-deploy.sh prints at run time (e.g. '3. Doc-lint', '13. Whole-tree orphan detection') rather than guessing numbers from memory -- the numbering is not fixed across repository states and an unnarrowed run's own output is the authoritative source for which gate number covers which concern.
